create_sequential_feature_selector: create a SequentialFeatureSelector to perform forward or backward feature selection using cross-validation scoring
fit_sequential_feature_selector: fit a SequentialFeatureSelector to learn the optimal feature subset from training data
get_support_sequential_feature_selector: get the boolean mask of selected features from a fitted SequentialFeatureSelector
transform_sequential_feature_selector: transform input data by selecting only the features chosen by a fitted SequentialFeatureSelector
get_metadata_routing_sequential_feature_: get the metadata routing configuration of a SequentialFeatureSelector for passing params to estimator cv and scorer
